title: Capacity Visor: per-tenant scaling knobs, throughput telemetry, and edit provenance
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Add a new Console surface (Capacity Visor) that lets operators inspect and control dedicated fleet lanes at tenant and route granularity. The feature groups three capabilities: (1) lightweight scaling knobs and preset profiles for immediate overrides and scheduled rules, (2) a throughput-first telemetry dashboard with per-tenant and per-route breakdowns, and (3) an immutable edit provenance timeline (change history) with diffs, actor, and rollback actions. This work aims to reduce MTTD/MTTR for capacity incidents and provide clear auditing for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Scaling panel: operator can apply scaling presets (conservative, balanced, aggressive) or set an absolute target QPS and burst headroom for a tenant. Changes persist and are pushed to the control plane within 15s.
Rule scheduler: operator can schedule a scaling change with start/end times and recurrence; scheduled rules show next-run and allow preview of capacity delta.
Telemetry: throughput dashboard shows 1m/5m/1h aggregated throughput, median latency, p99 latency, and utilization vs reserved capacity, filterable by tenant, route, and time window (up to 30d).

Provenance timeline: every edit is recorded as an immutable audit entry with who/when/what (diff snapshot). Operator can view a human-readable diff, and initiate a rollback to any previous config with one click; rollback creates a new audit entry.
RBAC: read-only operators cannot perform writes; write actions are gated to roles with "capacity:manage" permission. Attempts to edit without permissions show a clear CTA to request access.
Export: timeline and dashboard data can be exported as CSV for a selected time range and tenant.
Performance: dashboard queries must return for 95% of requests in under 800ms against our telemetry store for 30d windows.
E2E test coverage: automated smoke tests for apply/push, schedule creation, rollback flow, and permission gating merged to master.
notes: Trade-offs: we prioritize operator speed over presenting every knob. Start with three presets + direct QPS override; follow-up will add fine-grained CPU/GPU pool pinning.
Telemetry backend: rely on ENG telemetry API (ENG-4123) to avoid duplicating ingestion; dashboard will use pre-aggregated 1m tiles to meet perf SLO.
Audit storage: provenance stored in append-only store (ENG-5589) with SHA diff references. For now, retain 90 days; enterprise retention add-on later.
Design: compact panel on fleet detail view, and a standalone Visor app with full timeline. Mobile/compact not in scope for initial release.

2025-02-12: backend PRs merged; console feature branch open
decisions: Use three presets instead of a slider to encourage conservative defaults and reduce operator error.
Record full config snapshots for each edit rather than storing only deltas to simplify rollback semantics.
Schedule preview will simulate expected capacity delta using historical traffic for the selected window (first-pass approximation).
open_questions: Should scheduled rules run in the tenant's home region only, or be cross-region-aware? (SRE input required).
Retention: 90 days chosen as default—enterprise retention policy and costs need pricing input.
Do we expose per-route cost delta estimation when applying presets? (requires Optimize team vet).
next_steps: Finish console UI acceptance tests and integrate telemetry query optimizations (ENG-4123).
Create runbook steps for SRE: capacity drift detection and rollback playbook.
Coordinate with Sales for enterprise demo script and retention upgrade FAQ.
